messages:
sam: Quick check-in — week 1 after rollout: we're seeing a spike in pagination timeouts on multi-page exports. Need to decide scope: emergency patch vs scheduled refactor. Short thread to lock plan.
rachel: Can someone share numbers? is this affecting only exports or also daily list loads?
omar: Affected endpoints: /conversations/list (mostly large accounts) and /export/csv. 95th latency up from 300ms to ~1.2s under burst. Errors ~0.6% -> mostly timeouts.
sre-bot: alert: pagination-timeout-rate increased above threshold at 1753214300.
sam: Impact: two enterprise customers filed support tickets. Risk: bad experience for first-run flows.
kai: Proposed split for sprint: 50% reliability (including a fast patch to add cursor throttling), 30% enhancements (compact-mode request from customers B+C), 20% exploratory (profiler + longer refactor).
omar: I can own a quick throttle patch — target: reduce page-size default from 500 -> 200 and add backpressure header. Patch estimate: 1 day + smoke tests.
rachel: Compact-mode is an enhancement but high signal from AE. If we can do a tiny MVP that toggles page size client-side via flag, could be 2 dev-days and unblock both customers.
sam: Privacy/legal note: exports might include user metadata; need a quick review but this change doesn't alter export schema. I cc'ed @cm-team for a quick signoff.
cm-team: quick confirm: schema unchanged => no new review required. we'll spot-check logs if the flag goes to beta.
sam: Decision candidates: A) emergency patch only (throttle + revert page-size back later), B) patch + small feature flag for compact-mode, C) schedule refactor next sprint and communicate slowdown. Vote with emoji.
omar: :one: (A) — prefer minimal blast radius.
rachel: :two: (B) — prefer unblock customers quickly if low risk.
kai: :two: (B)
cm-team: :two: (B)
sre-bot: deploy started by omar on canary slot: pagination-patch-canary @1753214338
sre-bot: canary success @1753214345
sam: Good. Plan locked: do patch + feature flag (B). Owners: omar (patch + canary), rachel (compact-mode UX + flag), kai (capacity split and tracking). Reserve 50% eng for reliability this sprint.
omar: I'll open BUG-TG-7623 for the throttle patch and link the canary logs.
rachel: I'll create ENH-8901 for compact-mode feature-flag and mock up client toggles. Keep it feature-flagged and off by default.
sam: Communications: draft a customer note: "We're rolling a targeted improvement to page loads for large accounts; export schema unchanged. We're monitoring and will follow up." I'll circulate.
kai: Ops ask: add a temporary dashboard tile for large-account 95th latency and export error-rate for the next 7 days.
cm-team: AE coordination: we'll offer customer B a private beta flag once canary stable.
sam: Closing checklist: BUG-TG-7623 (omar), ENH-8901 (rachel), dashboard tile (kai). If no objections in 2 hours, freeze this plan and groom sprint.
omar: ack — starting PR now and will link test snippet.
rachel: will post UX mock in the ticket by EOD.
sre-bot: canary promoted to prod at 1753214358 (pagination-patch v1.0.1) — monitoring enabled.
sam: prod looks stable so far; will hold communication until 24h of metrics. Thanks team.
